name: Shelly BLU Button Tough 1 ZB
summary: Rugged single-button CR2032 remote with Bluetooth LE and Zigbee, multi-click, water/dust resistant.

requires: Shelly BLE gateway (any Shelly Plus/Pro/Gen3/Gen4 device) or a Zigbee coordinator

extra.ruggedness: shock, water and dust resistant (no IP rating given)

gotchas: No Wi-Fi — needs a Shelly BLE gateway (any Plus/Pro/Gen3/Gen4 device in range) or a Zigbee coordinator to reach the network
BLE range only ~10m indoors; place a gateway-capable Shelly nearby
Water/dust resistance claimed but no IP rating in the KB
CR2032 coin cell (~2 years); factory reset only possible shortly after battery insertion
best_for: Scene/garage/light trigger in a garage, workshop or outdoors where a fragile button won't survive
not_for: setups with no Shelly gateway or Zigbee hub
multi-button scene control (see BLU RC Button 4)
